newsitem.title: USA: Continental to buy 40 Boeing jets - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Continental to buy 40 Boeing jets - WSJ.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc. has tentatively agreed to buy 40 jets from Boeing Co. and was expected to declare itself an exclusive customer of the aircraft manufacturer, the Wall Street Journal said on Wednesday.
In its electronic edition, the paper said the twin-engine jets are valued at about $4 billion based on list prices.
The Journal also said the deal could further flare European rage about Boeing's lengthening list of exclusive-supplier contracts with U.S. carriers.
Boeing already has "sole-supplier" agreements with Delta Air Lines Inc. and AMR Corp's American Airlines.
Continental's board has not yet approved the agreement.
